The located studies. Every study located by the structured search that fits a model on a medical signal, an image or a record, with the non-signal comparator arm it reported and its bearing on this audit's claims. Rows are grouped by the sub-question of the search protocol they answer and ordered by year within each group. Reporting guidance and methodological studies are argued in the Background instead, because a reporting guideline reports no comparator arm.

| [zech2018] | Chest radiographs, pneumonia, three institutions | Yes, implicitly: site identity alone, a non-physiological variable | Supports, and supplies the cleanest analogue |
| [badgeley2019] | Pelvic radiographs, hip fracture, one health system | Yes, and it is the arm this audit proposes: process-only, no signal. It won | Challenges the novelty claim and supports the recommendation |
